title: Amount of a Back-Billed FlexLine Draw Fee
content:
**Clause — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The back-billed draw fee is the tier's draw fee percent of the draw, rounded to the cent and not less than the tier's minimum draw fee. The draw being billed is the line's most recent draw by draw date (of two draws on the same date, the one recorded first).

1. The draw is the most recent draw entry on the line by draw date; of two dated the same day, the one recorded first.
2. The tier's draw fee percent of that draw is rounded to the cent.
3. A figure below the tier's minimum draw fee is raised to it.
4. Every rounding to the cent takes an exact half cent to the even cent; the fee is rounded to the cent once more at the end.

The percent and the minimum fee are the line's tier figures in the product's draw terms.

## Worked figures (hypothetical draws)

| Tier | Draw | Percent of the draw | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Standard | 1400.00 | 2.5% gives 35.00 | 35.00 USD |
| FlexLine Standard | 150.00 | 2.5% gives 3.75 | 5.00 USD (minimum) |
| FlexLine Preferred | 300.00 | 1.0% gives 3.00 | 5.00 USD (minimum) |
| FlexLine Plus | 2025.00 | 2.0% gives 40.50 | 40.50 USD |
